world.title: Indian Man Wins Rs 12.9 Crore Lottery After 33 Years In UAE, Eyes Golden Visa
world.summary: An Indian man, Kishore Pandurang Rao, residing in the UAE for over 33 years, won Dh5 million (approximately Rs 12.95 crore) in the UAE Lottery. Initially in disbelief, he confirmed his win after seeing his name in news reports. Rao plans to apply for a UAE Golden Visa and intends to travel following his lottery success.

world.title: 'Matter of when, not if': US ready to hit Iran within 96 hours of Trump's nod
world.summary: US forces in the Middle East are ready to initiate significant military operations against Iran within 96 hours of receiving an order from President Trump. This heightened state of readiness follows concerns about potential Iranian retaliation if hostilities resume. The situation underscores the escalating tensions between the US, Israel, and Iran amid ongoing geopolitical conflicts in the region.

world.title: After 30 years in UAE, Indian expat wins ₹12.9 crore lottery, hopes to get Golden Visa and travel the world
world.summary: An Indian expatriate in the UAE won a ₹12.9 crore lottery after 30 years of residency. Initially skeptical, he confirmed his win by checking his account. His priorities now include reuniting his family in the UAE and traveling the world. The winner expressed excitement about the possibilities that this financial windfall presents for his future.

business.title: IBC | CoC Cannot Withdraw Approved Resolution Plan Citing Improved Financial Position Of Corporate Debtor : Supreme Court
business.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that a Committee of Creditors (CoC) cannot withdraw an approved resolution plan once it is submitted to the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) for approval. This decision was made on October 26, emphasizing that the improved financial position of the corporate debtor does not justify the withdrawal of the resolution plan.

business.title: Natural Gas News: Mild Weather and Storage Build Outlook Keeps Sellers in Control
business.summary: Natural gas futures are experiencing downward pressure due to mild weather and an anticipated increase in storage levels, which favor sellers. December and April contracts are testing support levels as the week begins. The price decline appears to result from ongoing selling rather than isolated events, indicating a bearish outlook for the natural gas market moving forward.

business.title: Indian Overseas Bank Q2 results: Net Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 1,912 crore; asset quality improves
business.summary: Indian Overseas Bank reported a net profit of Rs 1,912 crore for Q2 of FY27, marking a 56% increase year-on-year. The bank also noted improvements in asset quality during the quarter. These results reflect the bank's ongoing efforts to enhance financial performance and stability in a competitive banking environment. Further details on operational metrics were not disclosed.

technology.title: How Snapchat wants to transform relationships between luxury fashion houses and consumers
technology.summary: Snapchat is exploring the use of augmented reality and artificial intelligence to enhance relationships between luxury fashion brands and consumers. At a recent event in Paris, marketing directors from luxury houses and press representatives discussed these technologies' potential. Content creators, known as Snap Stars, also participated, highlighting Snapchat's role in transforming the luxury fashion marketing landscape.

technology.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy Of Atlantis Trailer Showcases Lara Croft's Classic Adventure With Modern Gameplay
technology.summary: A new trailer for "Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis" reveals a modern remake of Lara Croft's classic adventure, set to release in February 2027. The preview highlights four main locations: Peru, Greece, Egypt, and Atlantis. Key features include the Atlas puzzle, battles against Atlantean monsters, and the perilous consequences of encountering King Midas' cursed hand.

technology.title: Apple expected to launch iPhone 18 family early 2027
technology.summary: Apple plans to launch the iPhone 18, iPhone 18e, and iPhone Air 2 in early 2027, likely between February and April. Production for the main iPhone 18 may begin in late November 2026. The new models are expected to include design and hardware upgrades, continuing Apple's trend of annual smartphone releases with enhanced features.

sports.title: Simmons brushes aside talk of 'chaos' in Bangladesh camp ahead of WI Tests
sports.summary: Bangladesh head coach Phil Simmons dismissed claims of chaos in the team ahead of the West Indies Tests, emphasizing the players' focus. This statement follows the recent removal of batting coach Mohammad Ashraful. Simmons reassured that the team remains united and concentrated on their upcoming matches, despite the changes in coaching staff. The team is preparing for the challenges ahead.

sports.title: India brace for Wellington wind with series win in sight
sports.summary: India travels to Wellington aiming to secure a T20I series victory against New Zealand. A win in the third match would clinch the series, marking a significant shift in their competitive history. Shreyas Iyer emphasizes the need for improvements in both bowling and batting against spin to enhance their performance. The rivalry has recently favored India in key encounters.

sports.title: India brace for Wellington wind with series win in sight
sports.summary: India arrives in Wellington aiming to secure a T20I series victory against New Zealand. A win in the third match would clinch the series, marking a significant turn in their rivalry. Shreyas Iyer emphasizes the need for improvements in both bowling and batting against spin as the team prepares for challenging weather conditions in Wellington.

health.title: 1 in 7 stroke patients in India is under 45: Why young Indians are at risk
health.summary: One in seven stroke patients in India is under 45, according to the ICMR National Stroke Registry, which tracked 34,792 patients from 2020 to 2022. This alarming statistic highlights the increasing risk among young Indians. Additionally, nearly 14 percent of these patients died before discharge, raising concerns about the factors contributing to strokes in this age group.

health.title: What your bedtime habit may reveal about your heart
health.summary: A recent study indicates that bedtime habits may influence heart health, highlighting the importance of a regular sleep schedule. Researchers found that an unpredictable sleep pattern during midlife is associated with a higher risk of serious cardiovascular issues. This suggests that not only the duration of sleep but also the timing of sleep could be crucial for heart health.

health.title: AI can boost early detection of tuberculosis and lung cancer, says Dr Randeep Guleria
health.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) may significantly enhance India's efforts against tuberculosis (TB) and lung cancer, according to Dr. Randeep Guleria. AI can facilitate earlier detection, accelerate diagnosis, and improve patient screening processes. Experts emphasize the potential of AI to transform healthcare outcomes for these diseases, highlighting its importance in addressing public health challenges in India.

science.title: Scientists simulated solar explosions in the lab
science.summary: Scientists have simulated solar explosions in a laboratory to investigate the Sun's outer atmosphere, which is significantly hotter than its visible surface. This phenomenon raises questions about the energy sources responsible for this temperature difference. Understanding these processes could provide insights into solar dynamics and enhance knowledge of solar activity's effects on space weather and Earth's environment.

science.title: Nasa's Swift telescope ends science ops, preps for crashing into Earth
science.summary: NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory has concluded its science operations after nearly 20 years of exploring energetic cosmic phenomena. The spacecraft is experiencing increased atmospheric drag, which has accelerated its descent. Swift is now preparing for re-entry into Earth's atmosphere, expected to occur in the coming weeks, marking the end of its significant contributions to astronomical research.

science.title: Retired Brookhaven Collider Delivers a Final Surprise as Oxygen Collisions Show Jets Losing Energy in Tiny Drops of Early-Universe Matter
science.summary: Oxygen collisions at Brookhaven's retired RHIC revealed that jets lose approximately 20% of their energy, indicating the presence of early-universe matter in small drops. STAR physicists observed this suppression of high-energy particles in 2021, suggesting that even small nuclei can briefly create a quark-gluon plasma, representing some of the hottest matter ever produced in a laboratory setting.

entertainment.title: Ramayana: ‘There’s no energy left to look at feedback’: AR Rahman says he remains unfazed by social media criticism as ‘Ramayana Rise of a Legend’ soundtrack sparks debate amid backlash for ‘Ravana Ta
entertainment.summary: AR Rahman addressed the criticism surrounding the soundtrack of "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend," particularly regarding the songs "Ravana Tandav" and "Mangal Rang." He stated that he has no energy left to focus on feedback and remains unfazed by social media reactions. The soundtrack has sparked considerable debate, reflecting mixed opinions among listeners and fans.

entertainment.title: 'Her Family Is Destroyed': Love Gill's Team Reacts To ScoutOP-Kaashvi Controversy On Bigg Boss 20
entertainment.summary: The controversy involving Love Gill, ScoutOP, and Kaashvi Hiranandani on Bigg Boss 20 is intensifying. Love's team criticized the situation, labeling it a "public execution" of her character. Tensions rose after Kaashvi confronted Love about her relationship with Scout, while host Rohit Shetty questioned their dynamic. The fallout is affecting Love's family and public perception.

entertainment.title: Subhas Chandra Bose's grandnephew Chandra Kumar Bose wants Fauzi makers to take down teaser for distorting history, hopes Prabhas pays heed
entertainment.summary: Chandra Kumar Bose, grandnephew of Subhas Chandra Bose, urged the makers of the film Fauzi to remove its teaser, claiming it distorts historical facts. He expressed his concerns on X after the teaser was shared by Suparno Satpathy. Bose hopes that actor Prabhas, associated with the project, will consider his request regarding the portrayal of history.
